verdict.line: You lose extended trades into Ornn's Q-E combo before level 6, but you win the matchup (51.7% over 232 games) once your health pool outgrows his poke.

brief.thesis: Ornn's Q (Volcanic Rupture, 9/8.5/8/7.5/7s cooldown) and E (Searing Charge, 14/13.5/13/12.5/12s cooldown) chain into a slow-into-knockup that punishes Mundo for standing still early, which is why Ornn holds the lane and solo-kill edge. Mundo's Adrenaline Rush passive and Q (Infected Cleaver) poke don't matter until his health pool is big enough to shrug off that combo, so the matchup flips once both of Ornn's cooldowns are down and items come online.

theirWindow.what: Back off immediately. The slow from Volcanic Rupture sets up Searing Charge, and if he hits terrain mid-charge the shockwave knocks you up for a full follow-up combo.

yourWindow.when: both Q and E on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Close the gap and throw Q (Infected Cleaver, 4s cooldown, 975 range) repeatedly. With his slow and knockup unavailable he has no way to punish you for standing in range, so trade autos and cleavers freely.

start.why: Runs at 48.3% win rate over 178 games and is the majority pick (61.2%) because it directly answers Ornn's poke-heavy Q and auto trades.

boots.why: 53.6% win rate over 168 games and the clear majority pick (64.1%). The extra move speed lets you close distance the moment Ornn's Q/E are down instead of eating another poke trying to walk up.

core.why: First item in the highest-performing path (66.7% over 39 games); the flat health scales both Infected Cleaver damage and your passive regen against Ornn's poke.
Second in that same 66.7% path; stacks health over time so your pool keeps growing relative to Ornn's magic poke.
Completes the 66.7% path; the bonus health and splitting slash add trade damage once you're tanky enough to stand in range.

runes.keystoneWhy: Used in the 54.9% win rate / 54.9% pick page; it heals and grows your health every time you proc it on Ornn's poke autos, directly countering his early trade advantage.

summoners.why: The most-picked loadout (56.9% pick, 49.4% win rate). Teleport lets you skip the dangerous early trades and reset onto plates, while Ghost closes distance the instant Ornn's Q and E are both down.

playing.title: Punish empty cooldowns
playing.detail: The moment Ornn's Q (Volcanic Rupture) or E (Searing Charge) is down, step up and land Infected Cleaver. Without his slow or knockup he can't punish you for being in range.

playing.title: Stay off terrain near his E
playing.detail: Searing Charge only knocks up if Ornn collides with terrain mid-charge. Fight in open lane space so a landed charge is just a damage trade, not a combo starter.

playing.title: Weave W during extended trades
playing.detail: Burning Agony costs your own health but deals continual damage to nearby enemies and shortens disables. Use it once you're committed to a fight, not as a poke tool.

playing.title: Pop E when low for value
playing.detail: Masochism's AD scales with missing health, so trigger it after tanking Ornn's combo rather than at full health.

playing.title: Bank R for his ultimate
playing.detail: Sadism's movement speed and regen burst are your best tool to dodge or outrun Call of the Forge God's elemental once Ornn hits 6.

playing.title: Expect sudden item spikes
playing.detail: Ornn's Living Forge lets him buy non-consumable items anywhere, so his gold is never 'unspent' — don't assume a recall means he's behind on power.

brief.patchCaveat: All win rates, pick rates, and the build/rune/summoner choices above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning for why those numbers hold is my own analysis of the ability kits.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being hit with Ornn’s (Q)-(E) combo! Contest lane with [Q] and close in once all of his skills are on cooldown.
